category: paid-download file host (网赚网盘), VIP
tier: 高级会员 / 尊享会员

free_tier.stated: Free registration gives 100 GB per third-party documentation; the free download path is throttled to tens of KB/s with ads and a wait, which is what the VIP tiers remove.

per_object_cap.stated: 单文件最大 10GB, stated on the vendor's VIP page.

retention.stated: '文件永不删除' on the VIP page: files are not deleted for inactivity.

egress.terms: The paid tiers meter traffic, not time: 高级会员 is 存储空间 1T with 流量额度 1T at ¥39.7/month (list ¥40), 尊享会员 is 存储空间 1T with 流量额度 12T at ¥197 per 12 months (list ¥480), which the page renders as ¥16.41/month.
egress.free_allowance: 1 TB (高级) or 12 TB (尊享) of 流量额度

interface_detail: Browser plus any multi-threaded downloader; the vendor advertises '支持下载加速工具' and '多线程 / 断点续传'.
tooling: Browser, IDM, aria2. No WebDAV and no documented API.
chaining: The cheapest paid file host per unit of traffic: ¥197 buys 12 TB, ¥16.4/TB, provided a user's files are already published by someone else on this host.

limits.value: 1 TB 流量额度 (高级) or 12 TB (尊享); 存储空间 1 TB both
25 次高速传输请求/天 (高级) or 100 次/天 (尊享); a counter of fast pulls, not of bytes
1 TB trafii allowance (gaoji) or 12 TB (zunxiang); 1 TB storage on both
25 fast-transfer requests per day (gaoji) or 100 per day (zunxiang); a counter of fast pulls, not of bytes

identity_cost.detail: Purchase is by card through a reseller (PayPal) or in-page; the account itself was not read. The vendor page promises '购买后稍等几分钟即开通' and no refunds.

reliability_note: A 网赚 host: it pays uploaders per download, so the catalogue is monetised links and the domain has changed hands historically. Files are advertised as never deleted, which is unusual and unverified.
confidence_note: Both tiers, the traffic allowances, the per-file cap and the never-delete claim were read off the vendor's VIP page. The 100 GB free figure is third-party.

evidence.proved: '高级会员 / 存储空间 1T · 流量额度 1T 39.7 元/月 原价 40元'; '尊享会员 / 存储空间 1T · 流量额度 12T 16.41 元/月 原价 480元 现价 197元'; '单文件最大 10GB'; '文件永不删除'; '支持下载加速工具'; '多线程 / 断点续传'

an earlier landing variant of the same page: '高级會員 / 25次高速传输请求/天 1000G儲存 39.7 元/月', '尊享會員 / 100次高速传输请求/天 1000G儲存 12.37 元/月 原价 960元 现价 297元' - a 24-month promo, which is why the per-month figure differs
third party: free registration '100G 网盘', download rewards '高额的现金下载奖励'

gaoji: 1 TB storage with 1 TB of traffic at CNY 39.7/month (list CNY 40). zunxiang: 1 TB storage with 12 TB of traffic at CNY 197 per 12 months (list CNY 480), rendered as CNY 16.41/month. Both: 10 GB single file; 25 / 100 fast pulls per day.

price_per_tb_month: CNY 16.4 per TB of 流量额度 (尊享, ¥197 for 12 months and 12 TB)
notes: The 25/100 次高速传输请求/天 is a true pull-count in the vocabulary's sense and is rare enough to record: the vendor sells a number of fast pulls per day on top of a byte allowance. The two page variants disagree on the 尊享 price (¥197/12mo vs ¥297/24mo), both promotions, and the conservative per-month figure is recorded. The page does not say whether 流量额度 12T is per month or per term; the arithmetic says per term, because a monthly 12 TB at ¥16.41/month would undercut the 1 TB/month tier at ¥39.7 by a factor no seller would offer. The 高级 per-TB figure therefore stays unstated rather than assumed. The term reading is the record's inference, not a vendor statement, so the row is ranked with the flag rather than used to decide anything.
binding_note: The 流量额度 is what binds: 12 TB for ¥197 is ¥16.4/TB, the cheapest paid traffic measured, but it can only be spent on files this host already holds - it is not a route to an arbitrary link.
